description: Interpretation-clause (Offer, Acceptance, Promise, Consideration, Agreement, Contract).
What agreements are contracts. Free consent, competent parties, lawful consideration/object, not expressly declared void.
Who are competent to contract (Age of majority, Sound mind, Not disqualified).
What consideration and objects are lawful, and what not.
Agreement without consideration, void, unless it is in writing and registered, or is a promise to compensate for something done, or is a promise to pay a debt barred by limitation law.
Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract.
Compensation for breach of contract where penalty stipulated.
Definitions (Company, Director, Promoter, Prospectus, Subsidiary, Holding).
Formation of company (Public, Private, One Person Company).
Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). 2% of average net profits for specified companies.
Company to have Board of Directors. Independent Directors requirement.
Power to compromise or make arrangements with creditors and members (Mergers & Amalgamations).
Punishment for fraud. Imprisonment 6 months to 10 years + fine.
Mutual rights and liabilities. Partners not entitled to remuneration, equal share in profits/losses (unless agreed).

Effect of non-registration. No suit to enforce a right arising from a contract shall be instituted in any Court by or on behalf of any person suing as a partner in a firm against the firm or any person alleged to be or to have been a partner in the firm unless the firm is registered.
